request.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. One real photograph for a Spanish-speaking adult beginner learning English. Natural everyday photographic detail, real material, skin, fabric and fur texture, soft natural daylight and correct perspective; NOT an illustration, 3D render, cartoon, collage, cutout or app UI. Full-bleed 3:2 landscape; no frames, padding, blur bands, vignette, watermark or captions. No letters, words, numbers, logos or brand marks anywhere, including on clothing, screens, books, vehicles, packaging and walls. A first-time learner must understand the action instantly on a small phone screen. Nobody looks at the camera unless the prompt says so. Do not imitate earlier course photos.

Image 1 shows Ana: about thirty, long wavy black hair, an olive-green button shirt open over a white top. Keep her face, hair and clothes exactly, and add blue jeans. Create a NEW photograph in a different place: a bright bedroom. Ana KNEELS on the wooden floor right beside a made bed, seen from the side. With one hand she lifts the edge of the bedspread, and with the other hand she pulls a plain black smartphone OUT FROM UNDER THE BED: the phone is in her hand, low at floor level, half of it still in the dark gap under the bed frame. She looks at the phone with a happy, relieved smile, as someone who has just found a lost thing. The bed, the gap under it, Ana's whole kneeling body and the phone are all sharp and inside the photo. Exactly one person and one phone; nothing else on the floor, no other furniture in front, no pets. Every visible hand has five natural fingers.

cost.basis: Reported usage at list prices checked 2026-09-24; before tax, not an invoice.
